shortDescription: The Dow Jones Index decreased 317 points or 0.60 percent on Thursday to close at 52064 points.The decline was led by IBM (-2.45%), Nvidia (-2.33%) and Amgen (-2.29%).On the upside, the strongest performers were Apple (3.53%), Walt Disney (1.44%) and Coca-Cola (0.35%).

title: The Dow Jones Index Closes 0.60% Lower
